title: とも限らない
meaning: there's a chance that, it could be that
meaning_example: There's a chance I might be transfered overseas in the future, so I'm going to learn English.

comments.text:
Informal clause + とは限らない/とも限らない

With 〜とは限らない、what comes before is not 100% guaranteed.

With 〜ないとも限らない what comes before it is not unlikely to happen (i.e. there is a possibility).

は or も? - も is for emphasis.
